definitions.logical_mechanism: The playful reasoning step that connects the two scripts (Attardo). Optional: absent means absurd or no-resolution; partial means playful only.
definitions.narrative_strategy: Surface form of the material (riddle-QA, 3-step-AAB, dialogue, list, trick-elicitation, anecdote). Arrangements, not premises.
definitions.script_opposition: Two scripts that overlap on a span of text/situation and oppose on at least one dimension (good/bad, normal/abnormal, actual/non-actual). Highest node in the GTVH hierarchy.

situation.backgrounded_incongruities: suspend, never explicate (talking animals stay backgrounded)
situation.focal_incongruity: pointer to the script_opposition being played

logical_mechanisms.def: Lead the audience to assume script A; the punch forces reanalysis to script B.
Treat disparate things as the same on weak similarity.
Valid-looking syllogism with a skipped or false step.
Push a premise to its absurd literal consequence.
Place incompatible scripts side by side with no connective.
Inflate dimensions or value systematically to mock-heroic.
AAB pattern plus break on the third.
Persist with a rule despite counter-evidence (automaton).
The utterance defeats itself; tu quoque recoil.
Treat similar sounds as similar meanings; puns and reanalysis.

note: Mined 2026-10-08 from Attardo (GTVH). script_opposition outranks logical_mechanism outranks situation. Adopt as JokeBlock schema extension: SO + LM become first-class fields, not free-text comic_structure. Staged for figgsite templates/schemas.
target_rule: Roughly two thirds of corpus jokes carry a target; empty target means non-tendentious. Target presence routes to taboo-gates.json.
